subject: Pilot qualification + next steps: cross-border prompt validation
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Gutiérrez <elena.gutierrez@lokalize.ai>, Kento Sato <kento.sato@omori-tech.jp>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot qualification + next steps: cross-border prompt validation

Hi Elena / Kento —

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Customer goals we heard: improve translation consistency and locale tone for EU markets (DE/FR/ES), and reduce hallucination risk for APAC markets (JA/KO).
- Primary success metrics: CLS-style quality score >= 0.82 on in-domain holdout, <150ms median token latency in-host, and regression tolerance <2% over production prompts.
- Initial scope proposed: 2-week prompt sprint + 1-week pilot evaluation on a 5k prompt set across the 5 languages.

Model recommendations (initial):
- rw-multilingual-7b-q4: good latency, strong generative fluency for short-context prompts (recommended for live endpoints).
- rw-multi-13b: higher quality for long-form localized responses; use as an evaluation target and fallback for problematic prompts.

Deliverables we'll provide this sprint:
1) prompt_set_v1.csv (seed prompts + expected outputs) — attached as a starter.
2) bench_results_eu_apac.pdf — example of earlier regional bench for similar customers.
3) mutual_action_plan.md — timeline + responsibilities + acceptance criteria.

Open items for you: please confirm final target languages (we captured DE/FR/ES/JA/KO) and any additional regulatory constraints (data residency / EU-only processing). Also confirm whether you need SOC 2 evidence before starting evaluation in your environment.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm languages & residency constraints by Thu 5/24.
- We kick off prompt sprint Mon 5/27 (2 weeks).
- Mid-sprint check-in with Marissa + Aditya on Wed 6/5.

I've attached the starter prompt set and a sample bench; Marissa will own the sprint planning.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: prompt_set_v1.csv (CSV, 14 KB)]
[Attachment: bench_results_eu_apac.pdf (PDF, 320 KB)]
From: Elena Gutiérrez <elena.gutierrez@lokalize.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Kento Sato <kento.sato@omori-tech.jp>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:01:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot qualification + next steps: cross-border prompt validation

Thanks, Connor — very clear, appreciate the recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Languages: confirmed DE/FR/ES for EU testing; JA/KO for APAC. We may add NL if the pilot goes well (separate ask).
- Data residency: for EU test traffic we need processing to remain in EU; can Redwood run the evaluation in eu-central-1 or provide a private VPC option?
- SOC 2: yes, we'll need SOC 2 Type II attestation before any customer data lands in a shared environment. Can Aditya share the cert and typical evidence?

On deliverables, we'd like to see an example of the prompt->expected-output mapping format (so we can provide our own test prompts in the same schema). The prompt_set_v1.csv you attached looks promising but we need a short sample with de/fr/es examples.

Finally, latency constraint: the <150ms median token latency seems tight for the rw-multi-13b fallback — is that target for rw-multilingual-7b-q4 or for both? We care mostly about UI perceived latency (end-to-end).

Happy to take a 30-min alignment call Thursday afternoon — Kento and I are available 15:00-17:00 CEST.

Best,
Elena
Head of ML Product
Lokalize
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Gutiérrez <elena.gutierrez@lokalize.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 13:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot qualification + next steps: cross-border prompt validation

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the scheduling window. Short answers and action items: 

- Languages confirmed: DE / FR / ES / JA / KO. We'll leave NL as an optional post-pilot add-on.
- Residency: we can run the evaluation entirely in eu-central-1 (private evaluation VPC) so EU test traffic never leaves EU. We'll provide a short runbook for the VPC handoff.
- SOC 2: attaching the standard evidence bundle (redacted) and a checklist. Aditya, can you confirm the expected docs and timeline for Loklize?

Attached: prompt_set_v1_sample.csv (3-example rows, one per EU language) and bench_results_eu_apac.pdf (sample earlier run). Those should help you map your prompts quickly.

On latency: median token latency <150ms target is for rw-multilingual-7b-q4 on our hosted endpoints in eu-central-1 under the batching profile we'll use for evaluation. rw-multi-13b will likely exceed that in some long-context cases — for UI perceived latency we recommend an A/B pattern: serve rw-multilingual-7b-q4 for interactive flows and route to rw-multi-13b for batch-only post-processing. We'll include model routing policy in the mutual_action_plan.md.

Next steps (concrete):
1) Elena/Kento confirm residency & internal stakeholders by Thu 5/24.
2) Lokalize to upload 200 seed prompts in the attached sample schema by Fri 5/24 EOD.
3) Connor / Marissa to create the mutual action plan and invite Lokalize editors to the drive (link below).
4) Kickoff call: Mon 5/27 09:00 UTC (we'll run through acceptance criteria + monitoring).

Attachments: prompt_set_v1_sample.csv, bench_results_eu_apac.pdf, mutual_action_plan.md

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 16:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot qualification + next steps: cross-border prompt validation

Perfect — thanks, Marissa and Elena. Confirming that I've created the mutual action plan and added Lokalize as editors. Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C-prompt-sprint

Logistics / commitments:
- Redwood will provision a private evaluation VPC in eu-central-1 for the EU test traffic.
- We'll run the 2-week prompt sprint (Mon 5/27 - Fri 6/7) and publish interim bench on Wed 6/5.
- Acceptance criteria: CLS >= 0.82 OR improvement of +8 points vs baseline for DE/FR/ES; no single-language regression >3%.

Aditya — please share SOC 2 Type II attestation and the standard onboarding checklist to elena.gutierrez@lokalize.ai. Elena/Kento — once you confirm the seed prompt upload, I'll schedule the 30-min alignment call Thu 15:30 CEST as requested.

Deal reference: LDL-2028-0531

Thanks all — looking forward to running this.
Connor
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
